# **Developmental Shifts in Social Status Detection Among School-Age Children**

## Notes on replication package

1.  The analysis script assumes that the R project environment is set to the folder containing the script and replication objects. File paths are therefore written relative to the project root. The required replication objects are: `replicationData.rds`, `sensitivityTable.rds`, `bootMatrixT.rds`, `bootMatrixWR.rds`, `bootMatrixSV.rds`, `bootMatrixWald.rds`, `bootMatrixWCR.rds` If the script is run from another working directory, file-loading commands may need to be adjusted accordingly.

2.  Bootstrap procedures can be run either in parallel or sequentially. The replication script exposes four tuning parameters for this part of the analysis: `runBootstraps`, `parallelSupported`, `availableCores`, and number of bootstrap iterations `B`. If `runBootstraps` is set to `TRUE`, the script regenerates the bootstrap matrices. If `parallelSupported` is set to `TRUE`, the bootstrap is run in parallel using `mclapply()` from the `parallel` package, with the number of cores determined by `availableCores`. If `parallelSupported` is set to `FALSE`, the script uses `lapply()` instead. Changing from `mclapply()` to `lapply()` preserves the logic of the bootstrap procedure but may not reproduce the exact same random draws, even when the same seed is set, because serial and parallel evaluation can consume the random-number stream differently. Exact regeneration of the provided bootstrap matrices therefore requires the original parallel configuration with `availableCores = 15`.

3.  The main bootstrap analyses use a large number of iterations (`B = 99,999`). To facilitate exact reproduction of the reported bootstrap p-values and avoid requiring users to rerun the full bootstrap procedures, the bootstrap result matrices used in the manuscript are included in the replication package as `.rds` files. The script defaults to using these files for the final bootstrap-based p-value calculations.

### Tuning parameters

```{r}

runBootstraps <- FALSE
parallelSupported <- TRUE
availableCores <- 15
B <- 99999

saveTables <- TRUE # Exports tables and figures to the project root
```

## Models

```{r}

vcovType <- "HC2"

# --------------------ONE----------------------

modelOne <- lm(PageRank ~ BMI + ToM, data=replicationData)

vcovOne <- vcovHC(
  modelOne,
  type = vcovType
)

testOne <- as.data.frame(unclass(coeftest(modelOne, vcovOne)))

robustOne <- testOne$`Std. Error`

pOne <- testOne$`Pr(>|t|)`

# --------------------TWO-----------------

modelTwo <- lm(PageRank ~ ThirdGrade + BMI + ToM + ThirdGrade*BMI + ThirdGrade*ToM, data=replicationData)

vcovTwo <- vcovHC(
  modelTwo,
  type = vcovType
)

testTwo <- as.data.frame(unclass(coeftest(modelTwo, vcovTwo)))

robustTwo <- testTwo$`Std. Error`

pTwo <- testTwo$`Pr(>|t|)`

# --------------------THREE-----------------

modelThree <- lm(PageRank ~ ThirdGrade + BMI + ToM + SelfStatusSchool + ThirdGrade*BMI + ThirdGrade*ToM + ThirdGrade*SelfStatusSchool, data=replicationData)

vcovThree <- vcovHC(
  modelThree,
  type = vcovType
)

testThree<- as.data.frame(unclass(coeftest(modelThree, vcovThree)))

robustThree <- testThree$`Std. Error`

pThree <- testThree$`Pr(>|t|)`

# --------------------FOUR-----------------

modelFour <- lm(PageRank ~ ThirdGrade + BMI + ToM + Grades + ThirdGrade*BMI + ThirdGrade*ToM, data=replicationData)

vcovFour <- vcovHC(
  modelFour,
  type = vcovType
)

testFour <- as.data.frame(unclass(coeftest(modelFour, vcovFour)))

robustFour <- testFour$`Std. Error`

pFour <- testFour$`Pr(>|t|)`

# --------------------BMI EFFECT SIZE-----------------

semiPartialToM
```

## Bootstrap refined inference

```{r}

modelList <- list(
  modelOne = list(
    call = modelOne,
    unrestricted = coeftest(modelOne, vcov = vcovOne)
  ),
  modelTwo = list(
    call = modelTwo,
    unrestricted = coeftest(modelTwo, vcov = vcovTwo)
  ),
  modelThree = list(
    call = modelThree,
    unrestricted = coeftest(modelThree, vcov = vcovThree)
  ),
  modelFour = list(
    call = modelFour,
    unrestricted = coeftest(modelFour, vcov = vcovFour)
  )
)
```

### Percentile-t method

#### Run

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
 
  set.seed(73387)
  
  percentileBootFun <- function(i, modelList) {
    
    rowList <- lapply(
      X = names(modelList),
      FUN = function(m) {
        
        bootData <- model.frame(modelList[[m]][["call"]])
        
        idx <- sample.int(nrow(bootData), nrow(bootData), replace = TRUE)
        
        bootSample <- bootData[idx, ]
        
        predictors <- rownames(modelList[[m]][["unrestricted"]])
        
        modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(predictors[-1], collapse=" + "))
        
        unrestrictedBoot <- lm(modelString, data=bootSample)
        
        test  <- coeftest(unrestrictedBoot, vcov = vcovHC(unrestrictedBoot, type = vcovType))
        
        seBoot <- as.vector(test[, "Std. Error"])
        
        thetaBoot  <- as.vector(test[, "Estimate"])
        
        thetaHat <- as.vector(modelList[[m]][["unrestricted"]][, "Estimate"])
        
        tStats <- (thetaBoot - thetaHat) / seBoot
        
        names(tStats) <- predictors
        
        return(tStats)
      }
    )
    
    names(rowList) <- names(modelList)
    
    return(unlist(rowList))
  }
  
  if (parallelSupported) {
    bootResults <- mclapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = percentileBootFun,
      modelList = modelList,
      mc.cores = availableCores
    )
  } else {
    bootResults <- lapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = percentileBootFun,
      modelList = modelList
    )
  }
  
  bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootResults)
  
  saveRDS(bootMatrix, "bootMatrixT.rds")
  
}
```

```{r}
    )

    return(pBoot)
    
  }
)
```

### Wild restricted bootstrap

#### Run

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
  
  set.seed(73387)
  
  for (m in names(modelList)) {
    
    restrictedData <- model.frame(modelList[[m]][["call"]])
    
    predictors <- rownames(modelList[[m]][["unrestricted"]])
    
    for (p in seq_along(predictors)) {
      
      if (predictors[p] == "(Intercept)") {
        
        rhs <- predictors[-1]
        
        if (length(rhs) == 0) {
          modelString <- "PageRank ~ 0"
        } else {
          modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ 0 + ", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))
        }
        
      } else {
        
        rhs <- predictors[-c(1, p)]
        
        if (length(rhs) == 0) {
          modelString <- "PageRank ~ 1"
        } else {
          modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))
        }
        
      }
      
      restrictedFit <- lm(modelString, data=restrictedData)
      
      restrictedFitted <- fitted(restrictedFit)
      
      restrictedResiduals <- residuals(restrictedFit)
      
      modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][[predictors[p]]][["fitted"]] <- restrictedFitted
      modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][[predictors[p]]][["residuals"]] <- restrictedResiduals - mean(restrictedResiduals)
      
    }
    
  }
  
  rademacher <- function(n) sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
  
  restrictedBootFun <- function(i, modelList) {
    
    rowList <- lapply(
      X = names(modelList),
      FUN = function(m) {
        
        bootData <- model.frame(modelList[[m]][["call"]])
        
        predictors <- rownames(modelList[[m]][["unrestricted"]])
        
        tStats <- sapply(
          X=predictors,
          FUN = function(p) {
            
            residualSample <- rademacher(nrow(bootData)) *  modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][[p]][["residuals"]]
            
            response <- modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][[p]][["fitted"]] + residualSample
            
            bootData$PageRank <- response
            
            modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(predictors[-1], collapse=" + "))
            
            unrestrictedBoot <- lm(modelString, data=bootData)
            
            vcovBoot <- vcovHC(unrestrictedBoot, type = vcovType)
            
            test  <- coeftest(unrestrictedBoot, vcov = vcovBoot)
            
            tStar  <- test[p, "t value"]
            
            return(tStar)
          }
        )
        
        names(tStats) <- predictors
        
        return(tStats)
      }
    )
    
    names(rowList) <- names(modelList)
    
    return(unlist(rowList))
  }
  
  if (parallelSupported) {
    bootResults <- mclapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = restrictedBootFun,
      modelList = modelList,
      mc.cores = availableCores
    )
  } else {
    bootResults <- lapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = restrictedBootFun,
      modelList = modelList
    )
  }
  
  bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootResults)
  
  saveRDS(bootMatrix, "bootMatrixWR.rds")
  
}
```

## Score-variance (cluster) test

Null hypothesis of no clustering structure (heteroskedastic baseline).

- MacKinnon, J. G., Nielsen, M. Ø., & Webb, M. D. (2023). Testing for the appropriate level of clustering in linear regression models. *Journal of Econometrics*, *235*(2), 2027-2056. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jeconom.2023.03.005

```{r}

svFun <- function(model, clusterID, data) {
  
  modelIdx <- as.integer(rownames(model.frame(model)))
  
  data <- data[modelIdx, ]
  
  G <-  length(unique(data[[clusterID]]))
  
  N <- nrow(data)

  scoreList <- lapply(
    X = 1:ncol(model.matrix(model)),
    FUN = function(X){
      
      X1 <- model.matrix(model)[, X, drop=FALSE]
      
      X2 <- model.matrix(model)[, -X, drop=FALSE]
      
      I <- diag(nrow(X2))
      
      Xtilde <- (I - X2 %*% solve(t(X2) %*% X2) %*% t(X2)) %*% X1
      
      res <- as.matrix(model$residuals)
      
      scores <- Xtilde * res
      
      return(scores) 
    }
  )
  
  scores <- do.call(
    cbind,
    scoreList
  )
  
  scoreNames <- colnames(model.matrix(model))
  
  colnames(scores) <- scoreNames
  
  scoresDF <- as.data.frame(scores)
  
  scoresDF$cluster <- data[[clusterID]]
  
  sigmaCoarse <- scoresDF %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x)^2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), sum)) %>%
    unlist() * G/(G-1)
  
  sigmaFine <- scoresDF %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x^2))) %>%
    unlist() * N/(N-1)
  
  theta <- sigmaCoarse - sigmaFine
  
  termOne <- scoresDF %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x^2)^2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ 2 * sum(.x))) %>%
    unlist()
  
  termTwo <- scoresDF %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ 2 * sum(.x^4))) %>%
    unlist()
  
  varTheta <- termOne - termTwo
  
  tau <- theta / sqrt(varTheta)
  
  pValue <- 2 * pnorm(abs(tau), lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    theta = theta,
    varTheta = varTheta,
    tau = tau,
    pValue = pValue
  )
  
  return(df)
}

svTest <- svFun(modelFour, "ClassID", replicationData)

svTest
```

### Bootstrap SV

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
  
  set.seed(73387)

  rademacher <- function(n) sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
  
  bootSvFun <- function(i, model, clusterID, data) {
    
    modelIdx <- as.integer(rownames(model.frame(model)))
    
    data <- data[modelIdx, ]
    
    G <-  length(unique(data[[clusterID]]))
    
    N <- nrow(data)
    
    data$PageRank <- rademacher(nrow(data)) * residuals(model)
    
    modelBoot <- lm(formula(model), data=data)
    
    scoreList <- lapply(
      X = 1:ncol(model.matrix(model)),
      FUN = function(X){
        
        X1 <- model.matrix(modelBoot)[, X, drop=FALSE]
        
        X2 <- model.matrix(modelBoot)[, -X, drop=FALSE]
        
        I <- diag(nrow(X2))
        
        Xtilde <- (I - X2 %*% solve(t(X2) %*% X2) %*% t(X2)) %*% X1
        
        res <- as.matrix(residuals(modelBoot))
        
        scores <- Xtilde * res
        
        return(scores) 
      }
    )
    
    scores <- do.call(
      cbind,
      scoreList
    )
    
    scoreNames <- colnames(model.matrix(model))
    
    colnames(scores) <- scoreNames
    
    scoresDF <- as.data.frame(scores)
    
    scoresDF$cluster <- data[[clusterID]]
    
    sigmaCoarse <- scoresDF %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x)^2), .groups = "drop") %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), sum)) %>%
      unlist() * G/(G-1)
    
    sigmaFine <- scoresDF %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x^2))) %>%
      unlist() * N/(N-1)
    
    theta <- sigmaCoarse - sigmaFine
    
    termOne <- scoresDF %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ sum(.x^2)^2), .groups = "drop") %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ 2 * sum(.x))) %>%
      unlist()
    
    termTwo <- scoresDF %>%
      summarise(across(all_of(scoreNames), ~ 2 * sum(.x^4))) %>%
      unlist()
    
    varTheta <- termOne - termTwo
    
    tau <- theta / sqrt(varTheta)
    
    names(tau) <- scoreNames
    
    return(tau)
  }
  
  
  if (parallelSupported) {
    bootResults <- mclapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = bootSvFun,
      model = modelFour,
      cluster = "ClassID",
      data = replicationData,
      mc.cores = availableCores
    )
  } else {
    bootResults <- lapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = bootSvFun,
      model = modelFour,
      cluster = "ClassID",
      data = replicationData
    )
  }
  
  bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootResults)
  
  saveRDS(bootMatrix, "../Data/bootMatrixSV.rds")

}
```

## Small-sample inference sensitivity analysis

To assess the dependence of the results on finite-sample inference choices, we conducted a small-sample inference sensitivity analysis. This analysis compared significance of results under alternative heteroskedasticity and cluster robust variance estimators, across asymptotic theory and both percentile-t and wild restricted bootstrap. Cluster bootstrap inference (wild cluster restricted) was also attempted, but the resulting reference distributions were highly multimodal, reflecting the small number of effective classroom clusters; these results were therefore treated as unreliable and are not presented along the main results.

### Function

```{r}

percentileFun <- function(j, vcovType, model, modelData, asymptotics) {
  idx <- sample.int(nrow(modelData), nrow(modelData), replace = TRUE)
  bootSample <- modelData[idx, ]
  fitBoot <- lm(formula(model), data=bootSample)
  V <- vcovHC(fitBoot, type=vcovType)
  test <- coeftest(fitBoot, vcov. = V)
  table <- as.data.frame(unclass(test))
  table$Type <- vcovType
  table$Variable <- rownames(table)
  rownames(table) <- NULL
  tStats <- asymptotics %>%
    filter(Type == vcovType) %>%
    select(Variable, Estimate) %>%
    right_join(table, by = "Variable", suffix = c(".x", ".y")) %>%
    mutate(
      tStats = (Estimate.y - Estimate.x) / `Std. Error`
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, tStats) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  return(tStats)
}

wildFun <- function(j, coefficients, vcovType, model, modelData, restrictedFitted, restrictedResiduals) {
  tStats <- sapply(
    X=coefficients,
    FUN = function(c) {
      residualSample <- rademacher(nrow(modelData)) *  restrictedResiduals[[c]]
      response <- restrictedFitted[[c]] + residualSample
      bootSample <- modelData
      bootSample$PageRank <- response
      fitBoot <- lm(formula(model), data=bootSample)
      V <- vcovHC(fitBoot, type=vcovType)
      test <- coeftest(fitBoot, vcov. = V)
      tStar  <- test[c, "t value"]
      return(tStar)
    }
  )
  names(tStats) <- coefficients
  return(tStats)
}

sensitivityFun <- function(B, testVec, model, coefs, data, parallelSupported, availableCores) {
  
  modelData <- model.frame(model)
  cluster <- data[["ClassID"]][as.integer(rownames(modelData))]
  G <- length(unique(cluster))
  
  asymptotics <- lapply(
    X=testVec,
    FUN = function(i) {
      if(startsWith(i, "HC")) {
        V <- vcovHC(model, type=i)
        test <- coeftest(model, vcov. = V)
      } else if (startsWith(i, "CR")) {
        V <- vcovCR(model, cluster = cluster, type=i)
        test <- coeftest(model, vcov. = V, df = G-1)
      } else {
        return(NA)
      }
      table <- as.data.frame(unclass(test))
      table$Type <- i
      table$Variable <- rownames(table)
      rownames(table) <- NULL
      return(table)
    }
  )
  
  asymptotics <- do.call(rbind, asymptotics)
  
  asymptoticsWide <- asymptotics %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(Variable, Estimate),
      names_from = Type,
      values_from = `Pr(>|t|)`
    )
  
  #---------------------------------PERCENTILE-T----------------------------------------
  
  percentileBoot <- lapply(
    X=testVec[startsWith(testVec, "HC")],
    FUN = function(i) {
      
      if (parallelSupported) {
        bootMatrix <- mclapply(
          X=1:B,
          FUN = percentileFun,
          vcovType = i,
          model = model,
          modelData = modelData,
          asymptotics = asymptotics,
          mc.cores = availableCores
        )        
      } else {
        bootMatrix <- lapply(
          X=1:B,
          FUN = percentileFun,
          vcovType = i,
          model = model,
          modelData = modelData,
          asymptotics = asymptotics
        )      
      }
      
      bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootMatrix)
      pBoot <- sapply(
        coefs, 
        function(c) {
          tHat <- asymptotics %>%
            filter(Type == i & Variable == c) %>%
            pull(`t value`)
          tHat <- abs(tHat)
          mean(abs(bootMatrix[, c]) > tHat, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
      names(pBoot) <- coefs
      pBoot <- as.data.frame(as.list(pBoot), check.names = FALSE)
      pBoot$Type <- paste0(i, "-t")
      return(pBoot)
    }
  )
  
  percentileBoot <- do.call(rbind, percentileBoot)
  rownames(percentileBoot) <- NULL
  
  percentileBoot <- percentileBoot %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(all_of(coefs)),
      names_to = "Variable",
      values_to = "Pr(>|t|)"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Type,
      values_from = `Pr(>|t|)`
    )

  #------------------------------WILD RESTRICTED-------------------------------------
  
  restrictedFitted <- list()
  restrictedResiduals <- list()
  
  for (c in coefs) {
    predictors <- names(model$coefficients)
    modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(predictors[-c(1, which(predictors == c))], collapse = " + "))
    restrictedFit <- lm(modelString, data=modelData)
    restrictedFitted[[c]] <- fitted(restrictedFit)
    r <- residuals(restrictedFit)
    restrictedResiduals[[c]] <- r - mean(r)
  }
  
  wildBoot <- lapply(
    X=testVec[startsWith(testVec, "HC")],
    FUN = function(i) {
      
      if (parallelSupported) {
        bootMatrix <- mclapply(
          X=1:B,
          FUN = wildFun,
          coefficients = coefs,
          vcovType = i,
          model = model,
          modelData = modelData,
          restrictedFitted = restrictedFitted,
          restrictedResiduals = restrictedResiduals,
          mc.cores = availableCores
        )       
      } else {
        bootMatrix <- lapply(
          X=1:B,
          FUN = wildFun,
          coefficients = coefs,
          vcovType = i,
          model = model,
          modelData = modelData,
          restrictedFitted = restrictedFitted,
          restrictedResiduals = restrictedResiduals        
        )
      }
      
      bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootMatrix)
      pBoot <- sapply(
        coefs, 
        function(c) {
          tHat <- asymptotics %>%
            filter(Type == i & Variable == c) %>%
            pull(`t value`)
          tHat <- abs(tHat)
          mean(abs(bootMatrix[, c]) > tHat, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
      names(pBoot) <- coefs
      pBoot <- as.data.frame(as.list(pBoot), check.names = FALSE)
      pBoot$Type <- paste0(i, "-WR")
      return(pBoot)
    }
  )
  
  wildBoot <- do.call(rbind, wildBoot)
  rownames(wildBoot) <- NULL
  
  wildBoot <- wildBoot %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(all_of(coefs)),
      names_to = "Variable",
      values_to = "Pr(>|t|)"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Type,
      values_from = `Pr(>|t|)`
    )
  
  return(list(asymptotics=asymptoticsWide, percentileBoot=percentileBoot, wildBoot=wildBoot))
}
```

### Run

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
  
  set.seed(73387)
  
  testVec <- c("HC0", "HC1", "HC2", "HC3", "CR0", "CR1", "CR2", "CR3")
  
  coefs <- c("BMI", "ToM", "ThirdGrade:BMI", "ThirdGrade:ToM")
  
  sensitivity <- sensitivityFun(
    B = B,
    testVec = testVec,
    model = modelFour,
    coefs = coefs,
    data = replicationData,
    parallelSupported = parallelSupported,
    availableCores = availableCores
  )
  
  sensitivityTable <- sensitivity[["asymptotics"]] %>%
    filter(Variable %in% coefs) %>%
    left_join(sensitivity[["percentileBoot"]], by="Variable") %>%
    left_join(sensitivity[["wildBoot"]], by="Variable")
  
  saveRDS(sensitivityTable, "../Tables/sensitivityTable.rds")
}
```

### Table

Sensitivity table reports p-values for the focal coefficients in the final model under alternative asymptotic robust sandwich variance estimators (heteroskedasticity and cluster) and its bootstrap-based finite-sample refinements.

```{r}

sensitivityTable <- readRDS("../Tables/sensitivityTable.rds")

hcPanel <- sensitivityTable %>%
  select(
    Variable, Estimate,
    `HC2`, `HC2-t`, `HC2-WR`,
    `HC3`, `HC3-t`, `HC3-WR`,
    `HC1`, `HC1-t`, `HC1-WR`,
    `HC0`, `HC0-t`, `HC0-WR`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = case_when(
      Variable == "BMI" ~ "BMI",
      Variable == "ToM" ~ "ToM",
      Variable == "ThirdGrade:BMI" ~ "Third grade × BMI",
      Variable == "ThirdGrade:ToM" ~ "Third grade × ToM",
      TRUE ~ Variable
    ),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Estimate` = Estimate,
    
    `A` = `HC2`,
    `t` = `HC2-t`,
    `WR` = `HC2-WR`,
    
    `A ` = `HC3`,
    `t ` = `HC3-t`,
    `WR ` = `HC3-WR`,
    
    `A  ` = `HC1`,
    `t  ` = `HC1-t`,
    `WR  ` = `HC1-WR`,
    
    `A   ` = `HC0`,
    `t   ` = `HC0-t`,
    `WR   ` = `HC0-WR`
  )

hcPanel %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Panel A. HC-based robust inference p-values",
    align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(hcPanel) - 1)),
    escape = FALSE,
    digits = 3
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 2,
      "HC2" = 3,
      "HC3" = 3,
      "HC1" = 3,
      "HC0" = 3
    )
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "hover")
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  footnote(
    general = "Entries are p-values except for the estimate column. A = asymptotic sandwich test; t = percentile-t bootstrap; WR = wild restricted bootstrap. HC2 is shown first because it is the primary heteroskedasticity-consistent specification used in the main analyses.",
    general_title = "Note. ",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}

format_p <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(x < .001, "<.001", sub("^0", "", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)))
  )
}

format_range <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  paste0(
    format_p(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), digits),
    "–",
    format_p(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), digits)
  )
}

summaryPanel %>%
```

## Self status test

### Exclusion restriction

#### Test for heteroskedasticity

```{r}

breuschPagan <- bptest(modelThree)

breuschPagan
```

#### F test, homoskedastic

```{r}

restricted <- lm(PageRank ~ ThirdGrade + BMI + ToM + ThirdGrade*BMI + ThirdGrade*ToM, data=model.frame(modelThree))

k <- length(modelThree$coefficients)

q <- k - length(restricted$coefficients)

n <- nobs(modelThree)

SSRu <- sum(modelThree$residuals^2)

SSRr <- sum(restricted$residuals^2)

FStat <- ((SSRr - SSRu)/q) / (SSRu/(n-k))

Pval <- 1 - pf(FStat, q, (n-k))

cat("F statistic is ", FStat, ", with p-value = ", Pval, ". We fail to reject that the coefficients on Self Status School are jointly equal to zero. \n\n")

anova(restricted, modelThree)
```

#### Wild restricted Wald

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
  
  set.seed(73387)
  
  modelList <- list(
    modelThree = list(
      call = modelThree,
      unrestricted = coeftest(modelThree, vcov = vcovHC(modelThree, type = vcovType))
    )
  )
  
  for (m in names(modelList)) {
    
    restrictedData <- model.frame(modelList[[m]][["call"]])
    
    predictors <- rownames(modelList[[m]][["unrestricted"]])
    
    restrictedFit <- lm(PageRank ~ ThirdGrade + BMI + ToM + ThirdGrade*BMI + ThirdGrade*ToM, data=restrictedData)
    
    restrictedFitted <- fitted(restrictedFit)
    
    restrictedResiduals <- residuals(restrictedFit)
    
    modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][["fitted"]] <- restrictedFitted
    modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][["residuals"]] <- restrictedResiduals - mean(restrictedResiduals)
    
  }
  
  rademacher <- function(n) sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
  
  restrictedWaldFun <- function(i, modelList) {
    
    rowList <- lapply(
      X = names(modelList),
      FUN = function(m) {
        
        bootData <- model.frame(modelList[[m]][["call"]])
        
        residualSample <- rademacher(nrow(bootData)) *  modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][["residuals"]]
        
        response <- modelList[[m]][["restricted"]][["fitted"]] + residualSample
        
        bootData$PageRank <- response
        
        unrestrictedBoot <- lm(formula(modelList[[m]][["call"]]), data=bootData)
        
        testWald <- car::linearHypothesis(
          unrestrictedBoot,
          c("SelfStatusSchool = 0", "ThirdGrade:SelfStatusSchool = 0"),
          vcov. = vcovHC(unrestrictedBoot, type = vcovType),
          test = "Chisq"
        )
        
        chiStar <- testWald[2, "Chisq"]
        
        return(c(chi=chiStar))
      }
    )
    
    return(unlist(rowList))
  }
  
  if (parallelSupported) {
    bootResults <- mclapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = restrictedWaldFun,
      modelList = modelList,
      mc.cores = availableCores
    )
  } else {
    bootResults <- lapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = restrictedWaldFun,
      modelList = modelList
    )
  }
  
  bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootResults)
  
  saveRDS(bootMatrix, "../Data/bootMatrixWald.rds")
}
```

```{r}

bootMatrix <- readRDS("../Data/bootMatrixWald.rds")

testWald <- car::linearHypothesis(

  c("SelfStatusSchool = 0", "ThirdGrade:SelfStatusSchool = 0"),
  vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(modelThree, type = "HC3"),
  test = "Chisq"
)

pBootChi <- mean(bootMatrix[,"chi"] >= chiHat, na.rm=TRUE)

cat("Chi square statistic is ", chiHat, ", with p-value = ", pBootChi, ". We fail to reject that the coefficients on Self Status School are jointly equal to zero. \n\n")
```

### Obtain fitted values in long format

```{r}

criticalT <- qt(0.975, modelFour$df.residual)

domain <- seq(-5,5,0.25)

BMI <-  c(rep(domain, times=2), rep(0, times=length(domain)*2))

ToM <-  c(rep(0, times=length(domain)*2), rep(domain, times=2))

predData <- data.frame(ThirdGrade=thirdGrade, BMI=BMI, ToM=ToM, Grades=0)

matrixData <- predData %>%
  mutate(
    "(Intercept)"=1,
    "ThirdGrade:BMI"=ThirdGrade*BMI,
    "ThirdGrade:ToM"=ThirdGrade*ToM
  ) %>%
  select(c(names(modelFour$coefficients))) #Order columns to match model covariance structure

matrixData <- as.matrix(matrixData)

VarPreds <- matrixData %*% vcovFour %*% t(matrixData)

sePreds <- sqrt(diag(VarPreds))

plotData <- predData %>%
  mutate(
    PageRank = predict(modelFour, newdata = predData),
    Lower = PageRank - criticalT * sePreds,
    Upper = PageRank + criticalT * sePreds,

  filter(-3 <= ToM & ToM <= 1) %>% # Exclude predictions out of support (no observations)
```

## WCR diagnostic plot

```{r}

targets <- c("BMI", "ToM", "ThirdGrade:BMI", "ThirdGrade:ToM")
```

```{r}

if (runBootstraps) {
  
  set.seed(73387)
  
  predictors <- names(modelFour$coefficients)[-1] #Exclude intercept
  
  restrictedFitted <- list()
  restrictedResiduals <- list()
  
  for (p in which(predictors %in% targets)) {
    
    modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(predictors[-p], collapse = " + "))
    
    restrictedFit <- lm(modelString, data=replicationData)
    
    restrictedFitted[[predictors[p]]] <- fitted(restrictedFit)
    
    r <- residuals(restrictedFit)
    
    restrictedResiduals[[predictors[p]]] <- r - mean(r, na.rm=TRUE)
    
  }
  
  rademacher <- function(n) sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)
  
  bootData <- replicationData[rownames(model.frame(modelFour)),] %>%
    mutate(
      ClassID = as.factor(as.integer(ClassID)) #Relabel and order from 1:G
    )
  
  G <-  length(unique(bootData[["ClassID"]]))
  
  WCRBootFun <- function(i) {
  
    rademacherDraw <- rademacher(G)
    
    rademacherDraw <- rademacherDraw[bootData$ClassID]
    
    tStats <- sapply(
      X=targets,
      FUN = function(p) {
        
        residualSample <- rademacherDraw * restrictedResiduals[[p]]
        
        response <- restrictedFitted[[p]] + residualSample
        
        bootSample <- bootData
        
        bootSample$PageRank <- response
        
        modelString <- paste0("PageRank ~ ", paste(predictors, collapse=" + "))
        
        unrestrictedBoot <- lm(modelString, data=bootSample)
        
        vcovBoot <- vcovCR(
          unrestrictedBoot,
          cluster=bootSample$ClassID,
          type = "CR2"
        )
        
        test  <- coeftest(unrestrictedBoot, vcov.=vcovBoot, df=G-1)
        
        tStar <- test[p, "t value"]
        
        return(tStar)
      }
    )
      
    names(tStats) <- targets
    
    return(tStats)
  }
  
  if (parallelSupported) {
    bootResults <- mclapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = WCRBootFun,
      mc.cores = availableCores
    )
  } else {
    bootResults <- lapply(
      X = 1:B,
      FUN = WCRBootFun
    )
  }
  
  bootMatrix <- do.call(rbind, bootResults)
  
  saveRDS(bootMatrix, "../Data/bootMatrixWCR.rds")
  
}
```

Wild cluster bootstrap diagnostic distributions. Histograms show the restricted wild cluster bootstrap t-statistic distributions for the focal coefficients. The distributions are highly discrete and multimodal due to the small number of clusters. For this reason, WCR p-values were treated as unreliable and are not presented along the main results.

```{r}

bootMatrix <- readRDS("../Data/bootMatrixWCR.rds")

plotBoot <- as.data.frame(bootMatrix) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(targets),
    names_to = "coefficient",
    values_to = "distribution"
  )

ggplot(plotBoot, aes(x = distribution, fill = coefficient)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.33) +
  facet_wrap(~ coefficient, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal()
```
